gm_lines: Choose one legal target within range. The target must be a battlefield-scale physical feature, a structure, a terrain zone, a formation section with physical anchors, a siege engine, a wall, a bridge, a gate, a vehicle, a mass of troops, or one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. Pure ideas, souls, memories, laws, oaths, and nonphysical effects are not legal targets unless the GM treats them as having a physical anchor.
Resolve one of the following modes.

Grind the Shape: A structure, wall, gate, bridge, siege engine, vehicle, or formation anchor section takes 12d10 Force damage. This damage ignores resistance to nonmagical damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points or overcomes its threshold, it collapses into Sand Terrain under your control. If the target is a major formation, artifact-reinforced structure, city wall, sect gate, or scene-defining object, make an opposed Cultivation Check; on a success, suppress or breach one meaningful section for 1 minute.
GM: Bury the Line's Blinded does not apply to a creature that does not rely on sight.
GM: Erode the Giant needs a Huge or larger creature touching a surface; its loss of Burrow and Climb Speed until the end of your next turn is not on this table.

Claim the Desert: For 1 minute, all ground in a 60-foot-radius area becomes your Sand Terrain. You decide whether each square is Shallow, Deep, or Storming whenever a creature starts its turn there. Your Sand Control Limit does not apply to this area for the duration. Once during each of your turns while the inheritance lasts, you may use Gather Sand, Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dune Bank, Dust Veil, or Quicksand Gate in the area without spending an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or CP. When the inheritance ends, created sand collapses into ordinary loose ground or remains as a changed battlefield feature if the GM rules the terrain was permanently altered.
